title: NeuroForge Plugin Manifest
description: Metadata file (plugin.yaml) required at the root of every NeuroForge plugin.

id.description: Unique plugin identifier used as a namespace prefix for validation. Must not conflict with any other installed plugin.

name.description: Human-readable plugin name shown in the Plugins page.

description.description: One-paragraph description of what this plugin provides.

homepage.description: Optional URL to the plugin's documentation or repository.

neuroforge_version.description: Required NeuroForge version range (e.g. '>=0.1.0'). Informational only — not currently enforced.

dependencies.description: Python package requirements this plugin needs. Informational only — the user is responsible for installing them in the backend image or virtual environment.

enabled.description: Set to false to disable the plugin without removing it. Disabled plugins are shown in the Plugins page but their pipelines are not registered.
